malformed_input.note: `value` is derived from `raw_value` by the ingest path, so the two cannot disagree on the wire; that case and a null tx_id are recorded but not required to be refused

noise_sweep.label: sensor noise scaled around the twin's calibrated level; the detectors were fitted at x1

concurrency.note: the rate limiter is shared state, so DROP(RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) under this load is correct behaviour, not a failure

source_parity.label: an identical legitimate command sent from each trusted source address

register_parity.label: small legitimate set-point changes on each of the 10 actuators (6 each)

stage_parity.label: the SAME step, in sigma of that sensor's measured normal spread, applied to one sensor of each stage

order_invariance.note: only order-independent rules are compared here; the rate limiter and the replay window are order-dependent BY DESIGN

live_offline_parity.note: the live monitor and the evaluation harness call the same scoring function on the same arrays

faithfulness.label: one stage is perturbed; the explanation should name that stage (model) and that sensor (invariants)

score_stability.reading: PSI below 0.1 is no meaningful shift, 0.1-0.25 moderate, above 0.25 large. The control re-runs the identical seed and must be 0: anything above that is real variation between healthy runs, not a measurement artefact.

slow_degradation.label: a sensor drifting slowly upward with no attack: the system should notice a large drift and ignore a tiny one

domain_gap.note: the live model was trained on SWaT and runs here on the twin; the standing measurement is docs/reports/twin_domain_gap_report.md

bounded_resources.note: a full queue fails CLOSED (the write is refused) and increments a counter the health endpoint reports

plc_allow_list.note: a spoofed source address still passes this check: it is defence in depth, not segmentation

rules.label: RULE-BASED checks on CONSTRUCTED scenarios (deterministic rules; NOT SWaT, NOT a learned model)

recorded_swat.source: docs/reports/physical_training_report_v2_swat.json (held-out test block, threshold fixed on validation)
